name: Managed Agents Lab 08 - fixture researcher
system: Read only the authored research fixture through read_fixture. Send a concise report to the coordinator and do not claim any write occurred.

tools.name: read_fixture
tools.description: Read the authored Lab 08 research fixture.

name: Managed Agents Lab 08 - change reviewer
system: Review the research report. You may request propose_write, but the host policy will refuse writes in this exercise. Report that refusal accurately.

tools.name: propose_write
tools.description: Request a fixture change; the Lab 08 host denies this reviewer capability.

name: Managed Agents Lab 08 - verified calculator
system: Use add_numbers for arithmetic. Return its host-verified result to the coordinator.

tools.name: add_numbers
tools.description: Add two bounded numbers in the Lab 08 host.
